title: Chronicle Snapshotter: residency-tagged, tamper-evident audit export and automated evidence bundles
creator: Aisha Turner
description: Build a service (Chronicle Snapshotter) that periodically materializes tamper-evident snapshots of admin activity (admin actions, access grants, config changes) with residency metadata and produces signed export bundles for legal/regulatory requests. Snapshots must be compact, replayable, and include integrity manifests notarized by an HSM-backed signing service. The exporter should support configurable retention policies, immediate-forensic exports for compliance requests, and integration with the existing archival tier (S3/GCS) and private on-prem sinks.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot generation on schedule with configurable cadence (hourly/daily/week) documented in config
Each snapshot contains canonical event sequence + residency tags + opaque token map and a cryptographic manifest (SHA-256) covering the bundle
Manifest is signed by HSM-backed key; verification tool validates signature and bundle integrity
Exporter can produce a single bundled archive for a given time range or user scope and attach export metadata for chain-of-custody
Automated retention policy applies: snapshots older than retention are transitioned to immutable archival storage and flagged as 'sealed'
End-to-end test that replays an audit snapshot into a local verifier and produces the same event sequence
CLI/API endpoint returns pre-signed download links with residency-aware routing (region-specific endpoints)
technical_notes: Source events: admin_actions stream + access_grants topic + config_changes topic via eventrouter
Snapshot format: newline-delimited JSON events + separate manifest.json (fields: first_event_ts,last_event_ts,event_count,residency_tags,manifest_hash,signer_key_id)
Signing: use existing KMS/HSM provider integration (kms-key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/compliance/cryptoKeys/chronicle-sign), sign manifest.json with RSASSA-PSS SHA256
Storage: temp staging in regional object store, final bundle copied to archival bucket with retention metadata and object lock flag where supported
Retention: retention engine will set lifecycle and object-lock parameters and emit retention-events to retention-audit topic
Performance: snapshotting must not block the primary event ingestion; implement streaming windowed compaction with near-constant memory by chunking and streaming hashes
Privacy: redact PII following current redact-rules config before snapshot materialization; store raw encrypted blobs only in sealed archival tier accessible to compliance with key access policies
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Internal alpha in staging - generate snapshots for a single cluster and validate signature/verification (2 weeks)
Phase 2: Beta - enable for a subset of customers on Dedicated and Hosted with opt-in exports; monitor performance and error rates; gather customer feedback (3 weeks)
Phase 3: GA - enable configuration in Console, add UI for export requests and retention settings, enable object-lock where cloud supports it (2 weeks)
Rollback: ability to disable snapshotting at org level and revoke signing key rotation if necessary
test_plan: Unit tests for manifest generation and hash plumbing
Integration test: produce a snapshot from synthetic events, sign manifest using test HSM, verify signature and replay events
E2E QA: run snapshot pipeline against production-like traffic in a canary region and validate latency impact (<1% ingest tail latency increase)
Security test: key access audit and simulate theft scenario to ensure sealed archive cannot be altered
Compliance test: execute export for a sample customer and validate chain-of-custody metadata is complete
